Team Spotlight: Mega Gardevoir Talonflame!

I think that this 6 may be the lowkey most slept on 6 in Reg M-B right now! Not only does this team have cool techs that do well into teams like Sun Rain and Zard-Y Toxapex, it also does well into Staraptor! So let’s dive in! (1/1?)
